decision_rules.FAIL: Preserve the exact auditor FAIL/UNCERTAIN/HOLD disposition; do not rerun or replace this allocation.
decision_rules.PASS: PASS_ADAPTIVE_FEEDBACK_METHOD_SCOPED only if auditor reconstructs all 13,312 rows, exact gates match in every arm, full release optimism increases with horizon, reusable median optimism is at least 20% lower than both full and aggregate at 16 queries, null false-superiority is lower than full, reusable planted discovery power >=0.70 and within 0.10 of full, and one-shot null lockbox coverage lies in [0.90,0.99].
